tasks.short: Examine freight and determine a safe loading sequence

steps.what: Read freight orders and handling restrictions
Physically examine freight condition, access and loading constraints
Determine the freight loading sequence

tasks.design: Use the warehouse module in {OPS_SYSTEM} to open the current freight order with its handling instructions in one native view. The supervisor still examines the actual freight and determines the loading sequence; no automatic instruction dispatch or loading action is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The supervisor navigates separate order and handling views.
tasks.enabler_now: A native linked order view can remove repeated screen navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Actual packaging damage, unstable shapes and access constraints are not reliably described by order fields.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognises an unsafe physical loading sequence.
tasks.altitude: Loading judgement and responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a warehouse order view can link handling instructions; a digital order does not replace physical freight examination.

assumptions: Boundary is examination and sequence determination, before a crew assignment, loading instruction send or actual loading. No new inspection log is introduced. An existing mandatory sequence record or dispatch must be added if part of today's task.

Order staff already supply freight identifier, destination sequence, declared size/weight and handling restrictions. s1 retains reading, verification and manual lookup of missing instructions; s2 supplies actual condition and access observations without new capture.
Test native linked views first. Only 1.5 points of s1 navigation disappear; 13.5 points of reading and exception lookup remain. No runtime, physical inspection or sequencing saving is claimed.
Shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates.
unknowns: Whether order views are already linked
Whether the supervisor must write or send a sequence separately
research_questions: Observe navigation separately from instruction reading and dock examination

already_counted.description: Read and verify freight restrictions, including missing-instruction lookup.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 1.5 navigation points less 0.4 upkeep. Conservative mixed freight has missing handling references, leaving only 0.6 navigation point removable and all manual searching retained: 0.2 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Schedule material shipments and transportation modes

steps.what: Verify shipment requirements, carrier windows and dock capacity
Compare feasible shipment times and transportation modes
Select shipment times and modes and resolve exceptions
Enter the selected arrangement in the existing shipment schedule
Check final shipment schedule and carrier destination
Send the final shipment arrangement to the carrier

tasks.design: Configure native time-window and mode compatibility filters in the transport module of {OPS_SYSTEM}. The supervisor chooses the arrangement, records and checks its final version, then retains a separately gated carrier instruction through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Explicit time windows and mode restrictions are compared manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native planning filters can show compatible options without deciding priorities.
tasks.still_hard: Carrier exceptions, fragile loads and conflicting priorities need judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor chooses which operational compromise is acceptable.
tasks.altitude: Scheduling authority stays with the supervisor.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: transport planning systems can compare explicit availability windows and mode constraints; no local outcome is measured here.

assumptions: Boundary is a shipment scheduling cycle that already records a schedule and instructs a carrier, not carrier procurement or payment. Separate actual dock/crew dispatches, if required, need their own timed actions.

Order staff supply shipment identifier, destination, deadline, load dimensions and allowed modes; carrier operations supplies available windows and dock staff capacity. s1 verifies and manually captures missing fields. s3 retains all exception comparison and negotiation; no producer gains unpriced capture duties.

Native compatibility filters first. s2 removes explicit matching only. s4 removes two points of repeated shipment-identification entry by selecting an existing shipment; the remaining 18 points include schedule detail entry, checking, repair and ordinary ungated saving. Existing runtime earns no labour saving.

s5 retains complete schedule, constraint and carrier-address checks. Any change to the final instruction or destination voids s6's approval. The real one-point send is fully retained and earns no saving.
Shares are provisional estimates. More missing-input repair than s1/s3/s5 allow lowers the estimate.
unknowns: Native filter coverage and missing-window frequency
Whether one or several recipients receive separate instructions
research_questions: Can the native filter expose rather than hide unmatched shipment requirements?
Separate exact-field matching from priority decisions in a scheduling observation

already_counted.description: Verify and capture scheduling inputs, handle unmatched cases, check the final schedule and repair entries.

incremental.description: Maintain mode/window mappings and test constraint changes.

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final shipment instruction and carrier address; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 20 explicit matching and two identifier-entry points, less 1.5 upkeep. Conservative exceptional freight has few comparable carrier windows: four matching points and 0.5 identifier point disappear, giving 4.5 minus 1.5 = 3.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inventory supplies and requisition needed replacements

steps.what: Physically count and inspect usable supplies
Enter counted supplies in the existing stock record
Compare supply stock with existing replenishment thresholds
Prepare the additional-supply requisition
Check needed supplies, quantities and requisition destination
Submit the checked requisition to purchasing

tasks.design: Configure native supply thresholds in {OPS_SYSTEM} and a requisition draft from the matched supply catalogue in {PROCUREMENT}. The supervisor retains counting, stock capture, quantity judgement and the actual purchasing submission, which is separately gated after the complete requisition exists.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counted supplies are repeatedly checked against thresholds and copied into requisitions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing stock and procurement modules can reuse item identifiers and approved thresholds.
tasks.still_hard: Damaged stock, substitutions and unusual future demand need direct checking.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognises whether counted stock is usable and replacements are truly needed.
tasks.altitude: Supply judgement remains unchanged; fixed comparisons and form entry shrink.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: stock modules can compare item quantities with explicit thresholds and populate supply requisitions.

assumptions: This is the requisition branch of requisition-or-purchase, using an existing supply catalogue and threshold policy. A direct supplier purchase needs its own commercial approval and actual order send; do not silently treat requisition submission as supplier ordering.

The supervisor produces usable count, item identifier and unit in s1-s2. Existing supply owners maintain item units, pack size and authorised replenishment thresholds; purchasing maintains catalogue destination and item codes. Missing mappings and counts are resolved manually within retained s2/s5, not transferred free to purchasing.

Try native threshold views and requisition templates first. s2 removes two points of catalogue identifier re-entry, leaving count capture, checking, repair and ordinary saving fully retained in 18 points. s3 removes explicit threshold comparisons and s4 fixed form population, not purchase judgement.

s5 retains full quantity, unit, pack-size, need and destination review plus fallback manual form repair. Excess mapping repair lowers the estimate. s6 is a real submission to a purchasing queue, separate from an author's ordinary draft save; its one point remains fully retained and earns no saving. Changes void approval.
The stock record and requisition are actual existing records used for replenishment. No new inventory log or staff tracking is introduced. Shares are model estimates.
unknowns: Whether this supervisor requisitions or buys directly
research_questions: Can the native template preserve units and pack sizes across stock and procurement?
Time physical counting separately from comparison and requisition typing

already_counted.description: Physical count, original stock capture, full requisition checking and manual mapping repair.

incremental.description: Maintain supply-unit mappings and authorised threshold changes.

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final requisition, quantities and purchasing queue; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes two identifier-entry, 15 threshold-comparison and 15 requisition-form points, less 1.5 upkeep. Conservative unusual consumables have incompatible packs and sparse thresholds: only 0.4 identifier, three comparison and three form points disappear; 6.4 minus 1.5 = 4.9.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and communicate checked transport prices to customers

steps.what: Clarify the customer's shipment and pricing request
Verify applicable rates, service conditions and exceptions
Quote prices for customers using explicit rates and surcharges
Populate the customer's existing quotation document
Check final quotation terms, amount and customer address
Send the approved quotation to the customer

tasks.design: Configure approved price calculations in {OPS_SYSTEM} and populate the existing quotation layout in {DOCS}. The supervisor selects valid rates, handles exceptions and checks the complete quotation before a separately gated, fully retained {EMAIL} send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Known rates are manually calculated and copied into quote documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native rate tables and quotation layouts can reuse selected shipment fields.
tasks.still_hard: Bespoke service scope, special handling and commercial discretion need human decisions.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor explains what the quoted service actually covers and spots an inappropriate rate.
tasks.altitude: Commercial authority stays with the supervisor.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: configured rate calculations and fixed quotation templates can replace repeated arithmetic and field copying.

assumptions: Boundary is a written quotation already sent by this supervisor within delegated rate authority, not a customer order or invoice. An oral-only quote needs different document/send shares; do not assume document work where none exists.

s1-s2 capture shipment identifiers, route, dates, weight/volume, service type and customer address and select approved rate revision, currency, tax and surcharge rules supplied by commercial staff's existing work. Missing fields and rate exceptions are resolved manually in retained s2/s5. No free new pricing database is assumed.

Test native quote calculation and template first. s3 replaces explicit arithmetic, s4 fixed-field copying only. s5 retains full amount/meaning/coverage/expiry/recipient checking and manual calculation or layout repair; additional repair lowers the estimate. Ordinary draft saving stays included and ungated.

The actual one-point customer send is separated and fully retained, with approval after the complete final quotation exists. Any amount, term, attachment or recipient edit invalidates it. Shares and upkeep are provisional estimates.
unknowns: Whether quotes are written or oral today
research_questions: Can the native template preserve exclusions and validity dates?
Time repeat arithmetic and copying separately from rate selection

already_counted.description: Requirement capture, rate exception handling, full final quote review and manual fallback repairs.

incremental.description: Maintain approved rate mappings and quotation fields when terms change.

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final quotation text, amount, attachment and customer address; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 20 arithmetic and 20 fixed-document points, less 1.5 upkeep. Conservative bespoke oversized shipment has manually negotiated terms and prices: only three arithmetic and four standard identity/layout points disappear; seven minus 1.5 = 5.5. The customer send remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A frontline supervisor who retains physical safety, allocation and commercial choices while native views shorten explicit comparison and document work.
skills_to_grow: Validate warehouse and transport constraint fields
Check procurement units and quoted terms
Bind dispatches to final checked versions
role.ambitious_version: Make existing operational records useful without adding unpriced capture or reducing supervision at the dock.
